name: Yuen Woo-ping
bio: Yuen Woo-ping (Chinese: 袁和平; born 1945) is a Hong Kong martial arts choreographer and film director who worked in Hong Kong action cinema and later Hollywood films. He is one of the inductees on the Avenue of Stars in Hong Kong.

credits.title: Blades of the Guardians
credits.overview: Dao Ma, the "second most wanted fugitive," is entrusted by his benefactor, the chief of Mo family clan, to take on a mysterious escort mission-escorting the "most wanted fugitive" to Chang'an.

credits.title: Septet: The Story of Hong Kong
credits.overview: A seven-part anthology film exploring the history of Hong Kong from the 1940s to present day.

credits.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
credits.overview: A new documentary film revisits the golden age of kung fu stuntmen and action directors in Hong Kong during the 1960s-'80s, exploring their pain and struggles.
